name: Elements Restaurant & Beehive Grill (Logan) Pan-Seared Salmon, Halibut & Filet Mignon
whyItWorks: Logan's premier sit-down grills at the Riverwoods and Main Street offer clean pan-seared Atlantic salmon, fresh halibut, and beef tenderloin with Yukon mashed potatoes or white rice.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Grilled Salmon, Halibut, or Filet Mignon cooked in olive oil with mashed potatoes or white rice and steamed carrots/squash (strictly hold any lemon-butter or citrus glaze).
watchOuts: Request no lemon wedge or citrus beurre blanc on fish
